maria.docs: Opening a small PR to update rate-limits/quota docs for the new metering header and dashboard links. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4311 :wave:
cheng: I'll validate Grafana panel IDs and export the updated JSON. New dashboard path is /d/usage-overview, panelId=58; will confirm post-export.
samir: I'll replace the old X-Rate-Limit examples with x-rw-metering snippets (Node/Python/Go). Keeping them minimal for quick-copy.
olivia: Please add a clear migration note about burst changes: per-route bursts now decay over ~1h (used to be per-minute). This hit support recently.
maria.docs: Good call. Also adding a short checklist at top: switch headers, update dashboard link, update alert metric to rate_consume_by_tier, call out burst decay.
samir: Draft snippets below to paste into PR:
Node: `await client.request('POST','/v1/generate',{headers:{'x-rw-metering':'usage=200;unit=tokens'}})`
Python: `resp = client.generate(..., headers={'x-rw-metering':'usage=200;unit=tokens'})`
Go: `req.Header.Set("x-rw-metering","usage=200;unit=tokens")`
docs-bot: Preview: https://staging-docs.redwood.ai/rate-limits-migration?pr=4311 :rocket:
cheng: lgtm from infra; I'll upload the panel export after merge.
maria.docs: Merging after CI green unless I hear objections in 30m. Thanks! :thumbsup:
